entry.name: jit.qt.videoout
entry.digest: Output video to QuickTime video output component
entry.description: jit.qt.videoout takes a matrix as input, compresses the data and sends it directly to a video output component (VOC).

messages.name: close
messages.digest: Close a connection to a video output component
messages.description: Closes the connection to an open video output component. The connection is automatically closed when the object is freed.

messages.name: getvoclist
messages.digest: Report the list of available video output components
messages.description: Sends a list of the available video output components out the object's right outlet.

messages.name: getvocmodes
messages.digest: Report the list of available video output component modes
messages.description: Sends a list of the available video output component modes out the object's right outlet. (e.g. the FireWire DV VOC offers NTSC and PAL modes)

messages.name: open
messages.digest: Open a connection to a video output component
messages.description: Opens a component connection for video output. You must open the connection before theobject does anything.
